sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of Keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Operational phone sitting at 15%. Standby to recharge before commencing patrols.
Ops phone standing on 23%. Now leaving standby and continuing patrols.
Patrolled through Lorne Street, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and High Street, commencing welfare checks and ensuring presence is visible.
Arrived at Fort Street, showing presence within the area and scoping for any vagrants or issues, all clear.
Scoped out Fort Lane, no issues.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full sweep completed, standby to show presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at check-in Corner of Customs and Albert Street Intersection, area has been thoroughly cleared.
Completed welfare checks along Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Bakery, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Little Albert's Coffee, Formery and Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Top of Victoria Street, welfare check commenced along all stores within the area, all clear. Standby to show presence and waiting on further response calls and incidents.

Arrived at last check-in Aotea Square, full sweep completed, huge inflatables present. Standby to show presence while waiting on further response calls. A few street vagrants present standing outside the old The Coffee Club but not causing any problems.
Report made on Community Patrol Team, reported a group of street-associated individuals congregating at the Fort Street pocket park area causing a disturbance.
Response call from Michael Hills, reported a male individual causing a disturbance inside the store, requesting assistance to escort the POI out.

Arrived at response location, POI had already left the store; due to new employees they were assisted by Auckland Council as they did not know our contact details. We gave them our contact number to call 24/7 throughout the week.
Arrived at place of interest Pocket Park, group of street vagrants not causing any visible signs of trouble; will continue to station presence here until further concerns identified.
Continuing patrols and patrolling through Queen Street ensuring strong security presence.
Arrived at check-in Top of Mayoral Drive, quick scope of the area making sure no concerns identified, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the area, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, few street vagrants congregating within the area, no concerns or problems occurring.
Arrived at check-in Corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, commencing welfare check on all stores and businesses within the lane.
Arrived at HQ, standby to recharge the Ops phone due to low battery (7%). Also taking our morning interval.
Response call from 51 Victoria West Street, reported a male individual causing a disturbance in front of their store.
Arrived at response location, male POI nowhere to be found. Called them back and they said he already left.
Response call from 151 Unichem Pharmacy Lower Queen Street.
Response call from Cotton On, reported a large fire inside the rubbish bin in front of their building.
Arrived at place of interest, the fire has been extinguished.
Member of the public stopped us and raised a concern involving a large bee hive on the sign at the corner of Queen and Victoria Street.
Arrived at the place of interest involving the wasp nest; contacted Auckland Council Warden due to a public safety matter. Standing by until they arrive.
Auckland Council Wardens have arrived. Standing by to keep the public safe and informed, directing them to cross the road or use an alternative path.
Now continuing patrols due to Council Wardens arriving. Leaving the matter to them to deal with.
Arrived at HQ, standby for lunch break and to recharge the Ops phone.
No issues occurred during this period of time. Morning shift completed. Equipment handover: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of Keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radios.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Having a little debrief with morning shift before gearing up to commence patrols.
Debrief completed, gearing up and commencing patrols up Queen Street.
Full sweep top half of Queen Street, arrived at Aotea Square; due to heavy footwork will commence sweep while showing presence, all clear.
Still currently at Aotea Square commencing sweep.
Currently still standing by at Aotea Square.

Received a call from W Cosmetics regarding a male vagrant taking shelter outside their store; as we were about to respond staff had already moved him along and no longer needed assistance. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep Aotea, welfare checks on businesses all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check City Central Library, no issues, all clear.
Welfare check Lorne staircase mural, all clear, no issues identified.
Full sweep Lorne Street, welfare check on all businesses, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Pl commencing sweep and welfare checks while maintaining presence.
Standing down sweep, received a response call from Cotton On regarding a female vagrant who walked out of their store with products. On route to location.
Arrived at response location, Cotton On staff gave us a description of the female vagrant. Patrolling the area to potentially spot the shoplifter.

While patrolling we noticed the female vagrant matching the description sleeping in front of City Central Library; confronted her and issued a verbal trespass from the store along with retrieving the stolen products, all clear, no issues. Heading back to Cotton On to return the products.
Products have been returned to Cotton On, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street, welfare check all businesses open, all clear. Arrived at Britomart commencing sweep while maintaining presence.
Currently still at Britomart maintaining presence while sweeping.
Currently still at Britomart standing by maintaining presence while sweeping.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, welfare check on all businesses. Patrolling Customs Street West.
Full sweep Customs Street, welfare check on all businesses, all clear. Patrolling down Fort Street.
Welfare check Gore Street and all businesses, all clear.
Welfare check Commerce Street and all businesses, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street, welfare checks all clear. Patrolling to High Street.
Welfare check Fort Lane, Shortland Street and all businesses, all clear. Patrolling up High Street.
Standing down patrols, received a response call from Lovisa regarding a female vagrant walking out the store with a lot of stolen products. On route to location.
Arrived at response location, staff told us the POI walked up Durham Street hill. Patrolling the area to potentially find the individual.
As we patrolled up Durham Street we identified the female vagrant described by Lovisa staff; approached her and retrieved the stolen goods. Heading back to Lovisa to return them.

Lovisa products returned to store. Received a response call from Cotton On regarding 2 female individuals walking out the store with stolen products, also notified they were walking down Queen Street; due to our whereabouts on Queen Street we decided to standby and wait for the two described individuals.

After a few minutes waiting in front of Lovisa we could not identify the individuals; called the store and were told they did not walk down Queen Street, they were up Queen Street. Patrolling the area to potentially find them.

After a long patrol we were unable to find the suspected individuals; went back to Cotton On to retrieve footage of the females and were told they would send it when they can. Heading back to office to charge ops phone.
Arrived at office charging ops phone and responding to any calls.
Received a response call from Mid City regarding a male vagrant inside the premises taking shelter and making the public feel uncomfortable. On route to location.
Arrived at response location, approached the vagrant and kindly asked him to leave; waiting for him to leave the premises.
Vagrant has packed all belongings and moved along. Heading back to office to continue charging ops phone.
Arrived at office charging ops phone and responding to any calls; 2nd guard has also arrived.
Floor checks complete, commencing toilet break before heading out to patrol.
Received a response call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a vagrant taking shelter inside; staff repeatedly asked him to leave but he refused. On route to location.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's, vagrant was not on site as staff had already pushed him out, all clear. Standing by at Britomart due to heavy footwork. (photo on file)
Currently still at Britomart standing by.
Currently at Britomart standing by showing presence.
Full sweep Britomart, welfare check McDonald's and public members, all clear. Heading back to office to charge ops phone.
Arrived at office charging ops phone due to low percentage, responding to any calls.
Welfare check Darby Street, Celines, Thai Food, Pizza Club, all clear.
Welfare check Elliot carpark, Dominos, The Fresh Market, Mr Snacks, Chicken N Chips N Fish, The Food Junction, all clear, no issues. Proceeding to Elliot Stables.
Arrived at Elliot Stables, heavy public presence inside the centre. Standing by for any issues.
Received a call to let the standby guard into the office. On route to location.
Welfare check Elliot Street and Elliot Stables, all clear.
Arrived at office, let standby guard in, all clear. Continuing patrols up Queen Street.
Welfare check Avachis, 77 Convenience Store, Hulucat, ChaCha, Timezone Centre, Midcity, Mcdonalds Queens, all clear. Patrolling to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear.
Received a call from management to retrieve the bodycam from office. On route to location.
Retrieved bodycam from office. Continuing patrols up Lorne Street.
Welfare check Red Radisson and Lorne staircase mural, all clear.
Whole of Lorne Street, top half of Victoria Street, all clear. Patrolling High Street.
Welfare check Freyberg Pl, Chancery Square, O'Connell St, all clear. Patrolling to Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101 standing by showing presence for any issues.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear. Heading back to office for guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to Night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at Bar 101 standing by showing presence.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Response call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual sleeping inside the premises. On route to location.

Arrived at location, male individual was indeed unresponsive and sleeping; confronted him, asked politely and he complied but then went to the checkout to ask for an order he had already bought with his money, sat back down, and we asked politely again to leave but he refused due to not remembering he bought food; repeatedly asked him to leave but he kept refusing. Standing by until he leaves.
Individual has successfully been escorted out the store and walked away from the area. Heading back to office to standby for floor checks. (photo on file)
Arrived at headquarters standing by for floor checks and doing Auror reports, charging the ops phone for full patrols.
Floor checks completed, charging ops phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at Bar 101 standing by showing presence for issues.
Removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public.
Removed alcohol from a group of individuals drinking in public.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Welfare check Victoria Street, 77 Convenience Store, Skymart Convenience Store, all clear. Patrolling Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear. Arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep Federal Square, welfare check Cathedral, Liston House, Ace Karaoke bar. Patrolling down Wyndham Street.
Full sweep Wyndham Street all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Shortland Street and Shortland Mart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to Fort Lane.
Welfare check Evans Kebab, all clear.
Arrived at Sapphire Nightclub standing by showing presence.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub. Continuing patrols down to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart, heavy footwork in the area, maintaining presence for any issues.
Full sweep Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear. Patrolling Lower Albert.
Lower Albert Street all clear. Patrolling up Albert St.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Patrolling through Swanson Street West to Federal Square.
Welfare check Swanson Street West, all clear. Arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep Federal Square, welfare check Ace Nightclub, Cathedral, Liston House, all clear. Patrolling Federal Street.
Federal Square all clear, no issues.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down to Victoria Street to Bar 101.
Full sweep Victoria Street West. Arrived at Bar 101 standing by till closing hours.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear. Standing by till the crowd in the area clears out.
Bar 101 crowd all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols up Queen Street.
Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's standing by showing presence.
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a female individual inside the premises threatening the staff because of an order she did not receive. On route to location.

Arrived at response location, approached the female and asked what the situation was and the reason behind the threatening; she told us she wants her order and will leave but staff insisted she retrieve her order. They were arguing back and forth but we quickly intervened and managed to de-escalate the situation. Standing by until the situation is finished and the female leaves.
Female individual has left the area and walked away. Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a female vagrant still inside the premises as they are about to close; she is refusing to leave. On route to location.

Arrived at response location, female was still inside the premises; we approached and kindly asked her to leave but she was refusing and talking to herself and making up words. Standing by waiting for her to move along with her belongings.
Vagrant has successfully been escorted out the premises, no further issues. Heading back to headquarters to commence 30 minute break. (video on file)
Arrived at headquarters commencing 30 minute break while responding to any calls.
Break finished, standing by outside till guard handover.
Night shift concluded, handing over to morning shift.
